backend_bugs.attack: Any legitimate group member lists/views a group or its messages; realtime events to members
backend_bugs.observed: Members (owner included) get 404 on GET conversations/{id}, empty conversation lists and no SSE events; conversation_messages lists show nothing. Writes still work (owner PATCH/DELETE, member post). With the rule patched to `members.id ?= @request.auth.id` (and `conversation.members.id ?= ...` for messages) verify_groups 55/55 and verify_delete 88/88 pass, as do all negative checks.
backend_bugs.expected: Members can list/view their groups and messages and receive realtime events; strangers get nothing
backend_bugs.suspected_cause: init_schema.py conversations list/view rule `members ?= @request.auth.id` (and conversation_messages `conversation.members ?= @request.auth.id`) never matches in PocketBase 0.39.4 for a multi-relation. Probe: `members ~ @request.auth.id` and `members.id ?= @request.auth.id` both work, `@request.auth.id ?= members` does not. Fix: use `members.id ?= @request.auth.id` / `conversation.members.id ?= @request.auth.id` in init_schema.py.
